notes: Coverage intervals are exact Clopper-Pearson intervals over 400 indicators.
Paired comparisons operate on the same evaluation replicates.
FPC variants multiply each method's half-width by sqrt(1-512/8192).
Whole-call bootstrap rows are fresh 2,000-draw recomputations with deterministic cell-derived seeds; the manuscript retains the sealed B4 bootstrap summary.

e3.interpretation_boundary: This inverts the existing mean-centred replay distribution as a location-shift sensitivity. It is not an exact randomization test of the composite causal null delta <= 0.002.

call_bootstrap.boundary: Paired calls are resampled within each realized assignment. This is conditional on realized item outputs and does not model item reuse across assignments.

e4.design_effect_note: 1 + 15 times standardized joint-minus-exact dependence; this isolates excess dependence relative to exact context and is not the total joint-arm design effect.

e5.analysis: E5 exploratory output-position and pair-distance patterns
e5.interpretation_boundary: Post hoc descriptive analysis of fixed outputs. Position and distance were not randomized as separate interventions, so slopes do not identify a mechanism.
